parsed.explanation: The worst documented features are tier-2/3: police use residual summary-offence clauses as extortion levers against LGBT people, a documented pattern of violence against trans women (69 cases 2018–2022; raw count without denominator, but in a small population it suggests a real, officially acknowledged pattern), and demonstrated justice-system failure — a magistrate refused a stabbed trans woman entry to court and dismissed her case. The life-imprisonment sodomy statutes are rarely enforced but remain a lever, with the savings clause blocking judicial repeal; no LGR and no hate-crime statute. Offsetting positives are real and current: the cross-dressing offence struck down in 2018, rising acceptance (72% in 2022), governing-party support for decriminalisation, pride under police protection, and state condemnation of attacks. No traveller-facing universal exposures (border, facilities, custody) are documented — open questions, not exposures. Sits in the elevated band between 0.35-style extortion-with-no-remedy and 0.55-style partial remedies: police extortion and thin recourse pull down, court relief and improving climate pull up.
